title: sanctions-alert
description: Structured second-line QA record for sanctions screening review. Captures program scope, list-management governance, screening configuration, alert-disposition sample (alert-by-alert), 50 Percent Rule and sectoral-sanctions handling, list-update event review, cyber-evasion exposure, material findings, and the QA recommendation. The skill produces QA artifacts only; the sanctions officer (and the firm's escalation chain) decides match-or-no-match, release, block, reject, or report. Schema version 1.0.0; additive changes only.

program_id.description: Sanctions program identifier (placeholder for sample). Stable across QA cycles.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this QA was produced.

as_of_date.description: Date the QA review was last revised. List citations carry their own date-as-of.

review_type.description: Why this QA is being produced. Drives sample selection, depth, and which sections of the artifact carry weight.

institution_type.description: Institution type. Drives sector-overlay selection and the screening-rail population the QA examines.

list_set.description: Lists the program screens against. OFAC SDN, OFAC SSI, OFAC FSE, OFAC NS-PLC, other OFAC programs; non-OFAC lists in use (UN, EU, UK OFSI, jurisdictional). Date-as-of every list citation in source_trace.

screening_rails.description: Rails screened in scope of this QA: customer onboarding, customer rescreen (delta or full), wire, ACH, card, faster-payments, trade-finance message, securities settlement, payments-processor, beneficiary-at-claim, other.

list_management.description: Governance over list updates, sources, and feed-mapping.

update_cadence.description: Documented cadence (e.g., daily, intra-day on OFAC publication, weekly, on-event).

last_update_date.description: Most recent list-update event the QA verified.

delta_vs_full_evidence.description: Evidence the program reconciles delta updates against full lists; controls preventing dropped designations.

feed_mapping_completeness.description: Whether all designation types from the list source map through the feed to the screening engine.

lag_against_ofac_publication.description: Measured lag of internal list publication against OFAC publication date. The OFAC publication date is the benchmark, not the institution's internal publication.

screening_configuration.description: Customer screening, transaction screening, match logic, fuzzy thresholds, and exclusion-list governance.

customer_screening_rules.description: Rule set applied at onboarding, rescreen cycle, and event-driven rescreen.

transaction_screening_rails.description: Rails screened in real-time or near-real-time.

match_logic_summary.description: Plain-language summary of match-logic algorithm class (exact, phonetic, edit-distance, vendor-specific). Cite vendor model where applicable; vendor model risk sits adjacent in aml-model-monitoring.

fuzzy_threshold_setting.description: Documented fuzzy-match threshold and the basis for the setting (BTL testing, vendor recommendation, calibration analysis).

exclusion_lists_documented.description: True when good-guy lists / whitelists / exclusion lists are documented with rationale, owner, refresh cadence, and re-review evidence.

exclusion_list_governance_note.description: Governance posture on exclusion lists; an undocumented good-guy list is a material finding.

alert_disposition_sample.description: Alert-by-alert QA sample. Each entry is a single screening alert reviewed for disposition defensibility. The QA reads each alert's documentation; it does not re-decide match-or-no-match.

rail.description: Screening rail (customer-onboarding, wire, ACH, card, trade-finance message, beneficiary-at-claim, other).

list_source.description: List the alert hit on (e.g., OFAC SDN, OFAC SSI, UK OFSI Consolidated, EU Consolidated).

match_score.description: Vendor-specific match score and the threshold it crossed.

disposition.description: What the screening function did with the alert. The QA reviews; it does not re-decide.

fp_rationale_category.description: Taxonomy category for the false-positive (or release) rationale: name-only-match, dob-mismatch, geography-mismatch, identifier-mismatch, role-mismatch, common-name, prior-cleared-counterparty, generic-or-boilerplate, other. Generic-or-boilerplate is itself a finding.

decision_maker_role.description: Role that disposed the alert. Independence from the relationship owner is a structural control.

evidence_pointer.description: System-of-record reference, document ID, or file path.

fifty_percent_rule_assessed.description: Whether the disposition record reflects a 50 Percent Rule aggregation read where the alert touched ownership / control of a designated person.

fifty_percent_rule_handling.description: Program-level handling of the OFAC 50 Percent Rule (aggregate ownership at 50% or more by one or more blocked persons triggers blocking treatment).

aggregation_methodology_documented.description: True when an aggregation methodology covering multi-owner scenarios is documented at program level and signed by the sanctions officer.

aggregation_methodology_summary.description: Summary of how the program aggregates ownership across multiple blocked owners and resolves edge cases (chain ownership, indirect ownership, beneficial-ownership conflicts).

evidence_basis.description: Evidence basis for ownership reads (corporate registry, BO certification, commercial database). Database-only reads on offshore structures are a known gap.

edge_case_handling.description: How edge cases are routed (sanctions counsel, OFAC FAQ reference, OFAC licensing route).

sectoral_sanctions_handling.description: SSI and other sectoral / restriction (non-blocking) program handling. Different prohibitions and different operational patterns than SDN.

ssi_handling_distinct_from_sdn.description: True when the program treats SSI / sectoral prohibitions distinctly from SDN blocking, not collapsing into one disposition path.

directive_specific_logic.description: Whether the program applies directive-specific logic (e.g., debt / equity tenor restrictions under specific OFAC directives) and how.

secondary_sanctions_posture.description: Posture on secondary-sanctions exposure (where the program has non-US activity or non-US counterparties touching US-sanctioned parties).

list_update_events.description: Material list-update events the QA reviewed (new SDN designations, new sectoral programs, FSE designation changes, jurisdiction-program shifts).

designation_type.description: Type of designation (e.g., SDN add, SSI directive change, country-program change, virtual-currency-related typology).

institution_response_evidence.description: Evidence the institution responded (full re-scan, delta processing, customer-base sweep, payment-rail re-scan).

response_timing.description: Time-to-response measured against OFAC publication date (not internal publication date).

cross_rail_consistency_checked.description: True when post-event cross-rail consistency is documented (a customer hit raised on one rail and not on another within the window is investigated).

cyber_overlay_assessed.description: True when the designation type was assessed for virtual-currency / ransomware / cyber-enabled-identity intersection.

cyber_evasion_exposure.description: Cross-cutting cyber overlay: sanctions evasion via virtual currency, ransomware payments, mixers and chain-hopping, cyber-enabled identity manipulation, deepfake / synthetic-identity, BIN sponsorship and prepaid-card abuse, decentralized finance and bridge exposure. Loaded when scope flags cyber.

virtual_currency_exposure.description: Program exposure to virtual-currency on-ramp / off-ramp, custody, or settlement activity that intersects sanctions risk.

virtual_currency_controls_evidence.description: Evidence of controls (blockchain-analytics vendor in use, address screening, attribution governance). Vendor outputs are vendor outputs; cite the vendor and route vendor-diligence to third-party-operational-resilience.

ransomware_payment_exposure.description: Program exposure to facilitating ransomware-payment activity (incident-response payment paths, cyber-insurance claim payments, remediation-vendor payments).

ransomware_payment_controls_evidence.description: Evidence of controls aligned to OFAC ransomware advisories and FinCEN ransomware advisories: pre-payment OFAC analysis, voluntary self-disclosure posture, sanctions-officer routing.

cyber_identity_exposure.description: Program exposure to cyber-enabled identity manipulation defeating name-and-DOB matching: synthetic identity, deepfake document fraud, identity-takeover at onboarding.

cyber_identity_controls_evidence.description: Evidence of controls (identity-verification vendor governance, biometric checks, anomaly detection) and how they integrate with the screening pipeline.

decentralized_finance_exposure.description: Program exposure to DeFi / bridge / mixer-adjacent activity through any rail.

material_findings.description: Criterion-aligned material findings against the sanctions program evidence.

criterion.description: Named criterion. The criterion is named, not implied.

framework_component.description: OFAC Framework five-component mapping (or FFIEC OFAC section) for the finding.

material_gaps.description: Specific evidence the QA reviewer flagged as missing. Each item carries the criterion it bears on.

recommended_gates.description: Recommended human-review gates to add or tighten in the sanctions program. Consultative input to the sanctions officer; the skill does not direct sanctions decisions.

required_reviewer.description: Role that should sign (e.g., sanctions officer, BSA officer, sanctions counsel, model-risk reviewer).

stop_condition.description: What state the gate stops on (e.g., release of an alert without documented rationale; list-update deployed without delta-vs-full reconciliation).

recommendation.description: QA recommendation. Consultative input to the sanctions officer or the BSA officer. The skill does not approve list configuration, tune match logic, file blocking or rejection reports, or close alerts.

recommendation_notes.description: Detail behind the recommendation: what to remediate, what to escalate, what process change to consider.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this QA artifact must clear before the recommendation is acted on. Drawn from references/review-gates.md when present.

owner.description: Role of the QA reviewer. E.g., second-line sanctions QA reviewer, internal audit secondee, advisory engagement manager.

approver.description: Role that signs off the QA artifact. Typically sanctions officer, head of financial-crime QA, or BSA officer depending on the firm's program structure.

confidence_label.description: Confidence in the QA read, per references/review-gates.md when present.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims in the QA. Every claim should be traceable; OFAC list citations carry a date-as-of.
